output.reason: The changelog line [ev-37207fd9c3f9] only says "improve performance", but the linked PR [ev-8ff8f9c617fb] spells out the change. The subject is the `argocd admin export`/`import` commands, as the changed files under cmd/argocd/commands/admin and the two command docs confirm [ev-071a8de98857]. Before this change they listed Applications and ApplicationSets in all namespaces, a regression introduced by #19510 [ev-052eecc39961]. Now they list all namespaces only when apps-in-any-namespace configuration is present, and otherwise only the current namespace, so installs without that configuration are the exposed group: their export/import is scoped to the Argo CD namespace. The PR does not name the exact configuration key, but that is enough to write the subject, change and applicability.
